items.title: Keyboard shortcuts work from a viewer pane
items.text: While a viewer pane had focus, most of your keybindings silently did nothing: Ghoztty dispatches them through the focused terminal, so only chords that happened to also be a menu shortcut survived, and WebKit claimed every Command chord before that. Cmd+Shift+. (rearrange mode), Cmd+1…9, tab navigation, and custom bindings now all work. Anything the pane itself doesn't claim — the page, a text field, the feedback composer get first refusal — falls through to Ghoztty. Typing and text navigation in the address bar, find field, and diff filter are untouched.

items.title: Reveal in Finder
items.text: A folder button beside Home opens the containing folder with the file selected. It appears only while the pane is showing a local file — a markdown doc, code, an HTML page, or an image — since a website or a diff has nothing to reveal, and it follows wherever the pane has navigated rather than where it was opened.

items.title: Cmd-C copies the image in an image pane
items.text: It previously had no copy handler at all.

items.title: A reveal on a path that no longer exists opens the nearest folder that does
items.text: A file deleted under its own pane, or a banner link to a missing path, used to be a dead click.
